args.query: boto3 S3 upload and download tested with moto mock_aws in pytest

results.title: boto3 S3 helper with paginated listing and presigned URLs, tested offline with moto
results.summary: A small boto3 S3 helper for upload, paginated listing, presigned GET URLs and batched delete, tested offline with moto's mock_aws and fake credentials.

results.title: boto3 DynamoDB idempotency and SQS queue tested offline with moto
results.summary: A DynamoDB conditional put for idempotent writes plus SQS send and receive, tested offline with moto mock_aws and fake credentials.

results.title: AWS SDK v3 S3 storage helpers tested with aws-sdk-client-mock
results.summary: S3 helpers on @aws-sdk/client-s3 for JSON put/get with NoSuchKey handling, paginated listing, batched DeleteObjects and locally signed presigned URLs, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and sdkStreamMixin bodies.

results.title: AWS SDK v3 DynamoDB document client and SQS events, tested with Vitest matchers
results.summary: A single-table DynamoDB order service on @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb with conditional puts, begins_with queries and optimistic locking, publishing SQS events, tested offline with aws-sdk-client-mock and aws-sdk-client-mock-vitest matchers.

results.title: pytest-mock: patch, autospec, spies and call assertions
results.summary: Core pytest-mock patterns on a small notification service: loose mocker.patch, autospec signature checks, mocker.spy over real methods, patch.object stubs and assert_called_once_with.

results.title: Starlette multipart form uploads parsed with python-multipart, tested offline
results.summary: Parse multipart text fields and file uploads in Starlette with python-multipart, then exercise the app fully in-process through httpx.ASGITransport with no network.

results.title: axios typed API client with axios-mock-adapter
results.summary: Build a typed axios client with a baseURL and an auth header interceptor, then mock GET, POST, 404, network error and timeout offline while asserting parsed data, the header seen by the mock and error handling.

results.title: Fastify 5 file uploads with @fastify/multipart
results.summary: Accept multipart file uploads in Fastify 5 with @fastify/multipart, reading fields and files, hashing content, rejecting oversized files with 413, tested with inject() and a native FormData body.

results.title: Capture loguru logs in pytest caplog via a propagate sink and structured extra
results.summary: Forward loguru records into stdlib logging so pytest caplog sees them, keep bound context as structured extra, and test it offline without a real log backend.

results.title: ioredis cache-aside with TTL, tested with ioredis-mock (Vitest)
results.summary: Cache-aside helper on ioredis with JSON values, TTLs, stampede-safe single flight and invalidation, tested offline with ioredis-mock in Vitest. Install uses --legacy-peer-deps because ioredis-mock 8 still peers on ioredis ^5, but the mock passes its tests against ioredis 6. vite is pinned so Vitest still resolves under legacy-peer-deps.
